name: Bahnfrei system-native CSV
source: docs/requirements/system-requirements.md SYS-013(a): a documented system-native CSV/JSON format
eventCodeFormat: <disciplineCode>/<categoryCode>, e.g. "100m/U16 M" — the discipline catalog code and one of the target event's category-scheme codes, joined with a slash; this identifies which programme event the row targets. The separate category_code column only needs a value when it differs from the eventCode's own category (a combined-category event, e.g. a mixed U16/U18 field) — it then names the athlete's actual entry category within that event; leave it blank otherwise.
